summary: 72,244 deterministic checks passed, zero mismatches. All six saved-query AP damage/identity outputs and supplied numeric wording reconstruct. Provenance, historical and live-runtime limits remain explicit.

checks.details: The analyzer consumes saved identity, AP and first-positive-rank records from the independent_global pair and creates no substitute labels. Independent-global AP is the comparator, not generated ground truth. Dataset-GT provenance is inherited; raw annotations and rankings were not re-authenticated.

Independently reconstructed every nonempty group and identity mean, full-N contribution, exact sign count, positive-only gain and negative-only loss. Checked within-group mean times group-count/full-N equals the contribution, both partitions sum to the overall delta, all identity means/macro/counts match, and the largest identity fraction uses the gross-negative denominator. No prediction-dependent normalization.

All producer input pins match, with SUMMARY/aggregate pins chained to accepted earlier artifacts. All 6,284 query records are valid and all 3,142 dataset-query keys align across conditions and the accepted A-minus-U records. Reconstructed all six outputs, 22 observed groups and every field in 264 identity rows. Totals/groups/identity means agree with saved SUMMARY and accepted all-six outputs; pooled results agree with the fixed-global difficulty analysis.

Read the 129-line producer and AST-parsed it without importing/executing it. Its summarize function is called for whole endpoints, groups and identities; imports and text I/O are standard-library/explicit UTF8. The independent rational verifier actually completed with exit0. Historical executor receipt records exit0/chunk e5cb09; canonical source/input/output aliases match, but historical tool-event/original-stdout authentication is outside this fresh reviewer context.

All 28 analysis table rows and 6 publication table rows match exact four-decimal rendering, and the draft numeric prose reconstructs. The boundaries correctly distinguish exact signs from significance, query mAP from identity macro, gross-negative share from net delta, and fixed independent-global comparison from same-model causality. MSVR repair groups are explicitly absent. Historical Signal/prior-objective and live operational statements are not newly certified. No correction is required for the bounded arithmetic or its descriptive wording.

Post-development saved-query description from declared dataset-GT evaluation records. This is neither a new benchmark run nor synthetic-proxy GT. The real_gt label describes the inherited scoring provenance, not a new raw-data certification.

scope_limits: Fresh native Codex same-family review; acceptance provisional. gpt-6-astra and max were requested. Actual service model and reasoning effort are UNATTESTED.

Read 15 supplied source/result/report/input/prior-audit/receipt/draft artifacts plus REQUEST.md; all 16 hashes recorded. Six saved SUMMARY files, accepted aggregate and fixed-global pooled results were the only numeric inputs.

Exact scope: 3 datasets, 2 original seed42 selected-best conditions each, 3,142 distinct dataset-query keys / 6,284 endpoint query records, 22 observed Rank-1 groups, 264 endpoint identity rows, 28 analysis-report rows and 6 publication-draft table rows.

No SSH, network, GPU, NN, optimizer/training, candidate/model change, producer import/execution, source/result mutation, raw-distance/annotation access, or replay of the earlier 59-file/463-source audit.

Declared dataset-GT provenance is inherited from accepted saved-query records and the supplied prior audit. This review does not re-authenticate raw labels, gallery membership, rankings, checkpoints, remote binaries or official evaluation implementation.

These are post-development descriptions of one original seed per endpoint, using each original selected-best model and development-consumed benchmark records. Exact sign counts are not statistical significance or multiple-seed/generalization evidence.
The comparator is a fixed independent global model, not the global branch of the same candidate. No causal branch attribution, unique internal failure cause or deployable GT-based gate follows.

Query mAP gives equal weight to queries. The identity macro gives equal weight to identities after averaging within identity. They answer different descriptive questions and neither sign supersedes the other.

Gross loss sums only negative query AP changes. The largest-loss-identity fraction divides its negative-query loss by all negative-query loss, not net mAP and not the count of negative queries. It is not the identity with necessarily the lowest net mean.

Exactly 22 nonempty groups exist: MSVR310 repair is absent for both conditions. No empty-group mean or completed zero-sample outcome was fabricated. Identity counts may overlap across Rank-1 groups and must not be added across those groups.

The draft references prior repair/keep and multi-positive trials, the complete Signal comparison, and current training/device policy/state. Those historical and operational clauses are inherited context, not established or freshly certified by these supplied saved-query artifacts. No live-state check was performed.

The original producer receipt is executor-supplied recorded history; its chunk/exit record was read and paths checked, but this reviewer cannot independently attest that earlier tool event or reconstruct unrecorded exact start/finish timestamps. The fresh verifier command, output, script hash and true exit0 were directly observed and preserved.
